verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus documents its own REST API with API keys that apps can use to act on an account. The API covers contacts (including bulk updates and upserts), campaign reports, list fields and starting automations, with documented rate limits and pagination, so the account can be driven programmatically without the UI. There is no CLI, no CI-specific guidance or tooling, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, so headless and CI use rests only on the raw HTTP API. Missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK for scripted and CI use, CI/automation documentation, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), and independent hands-on evidence of headless or CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use our API to give an application or website permission to interact with your EmailOctopus account.
Start an automation for a specific contact.
This system enables a steady request rate of up to 10 per second or a burst of up to 100 requests in a single instance if needed.
New API keys are compatible with all versions of the API.
